claims: Kenneth Blakeney is the head men's basketball coach at Howard University.
Kenneth Blakeney has held the position since 2019.
Howard Bison program had a 4-29 record in Kenneth Blakeney's first year.
Kenneth Blakeney led the Howard Bison to consecutive MEAC Tournament titles.
Kenneth Blakeney led the Howard Bison to NCAA Tournament appearances in 2023 and 2024.
Kenneth Blakeney was named 2022-23 MEAC Coach of the Year.
Kenneth Blakeney is a former standout player at Duke.
Kenneth Blakeney led Howard to their first outright MEAC championship since 1987.
Kenneth Blakeney led Howard to back-to-back winning seasons for the first time since 1985.
Kenneth Blakeney was BOXTOROW HBCU Coach of the Year.
Kenneth Blakeney was HBCU All-Stars Ben Jobe National Coach of the Year.
Kenneth Blakeney played under Mike Krzyzewski at Duke.
Kenneth Blakeney was a noted high school star at DeMatha Catholic under Morgan Wootten
